research_question: Does a local failed sweep reverse only when it occurs at completed higher-order external liquidity, while outside-value acceptance is handled as a separate continuation response?

selection.method: Deterministic SHA-256 sampling of Monday-start BTC weeks from 2021-01-04 through 2026-07-20, excluding weeks previously used for candidate-01 development or confirmation.

rules.selection_after_first_week: Use the primary whenever it advances. Use the reversal-only control only when the primary stops and the control advances. Freeze that rule before opening week two.

execution.data: Official Binance Vision USD-M BTCUSDT aggTrades represented one-for-one as NautilusTrader TradeTick

week_gate.advance_rule: Advance a weekly candidate only when it is full_pass or promising_but_not_complete. A promising result is permission to test the next frozen week, not project success.

long_evaluation_gate.prerequisite: All three frozen weeks advanced, at least two are full_pass, and the continuous three-week pooled NAV geometric daily return is at least 1% before any long-period runner is added.
long_evaluation_gate.long_run_must_be: One continuous NautilusTrader engine/account/strategy state, never stitched weekly NAV.

invalidation: Do not alter scenario rules, parameters, gate thresholds, weeks, cost, risk or execution semantics after viewing a frozen week.
Do not use ETH, SOL or XRP to rescue a BTC failure.
Do not open week two when both first-week rules stop.
Do not open week three when the selected rule stops on week two.
Do not create a long evaluation until the frozen weekly prerequisite is met.
